eventDetail.scope: ISPACS is an international symposium focusing on the theory, design, and implementation of intelligent signal processing and communication systems. The conference provides a forum for researchers from academia and industry to present leading-edge work in core areas of signal processing and communications, as well as related fields including circuits and systems, VLSI, and human-computer interface. It emphasizes both fundamental research and practical applications in emerging intelligent technologies.
